d: Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drive everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace—shaping how we serve restaurants, grocers, and new verticals worldwide. From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you.

We’re looking for a Commercial Project Manager to join our team. In this role, you will be the engine behind our local growth, leading high-impact commercial projects and using data-driven insights to refine our Consumer Value Proposition (CVP).
Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.
q: Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
Strategic Experience: Minimum 4 years of work experience, with at least 2 years specifically in project management or commercial strategy roles.
Analytical Prowess: Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and a track record of using data to drive commercial outcomes. Experience with Looker is a strong plus.
Commercial Mindset: A pragmatic problem-solver who can navigate ambiguity and prioritise effectively in a high-growth environment.
Effective Communicator: Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and coordinate complex teams.
Financial Literacy: A good understanding of P&L dynamics and financial modelling is preferred.
Industry Background: Experience in marketplace, consumer tech, FMCG, or consulting is highly desirable.
r: You will lead the end-to-end execution of strategic initiatives, acting as the connective tissue between Marketing, Operations, and Account Management. This role is a blend of project management, commercial strategy, and data analysis.
Here’s What Your Day-to-day Might Look Like
End-to-End Project Leadership: Lead key commercial projects from planning and delivery tracking to post-implementation reviews.
Cross-Functional Orchestration: Serve as the primary bridge between Marketing, Operations, and Account Management to ensure campaigns and shared priorities are executed seamlessly.
CVP Optimization: Use data and analysis to refine our Consumer Value Proposition, focusing on selection, affordability, and overall customer experience.
Market Intelligence: Monitor competitor moves and market trends to inform strategic planning and stay ahead of the curve.
Strategic Reporting: Own the reporting for growth and CVP metrics, providing the business with the data needed for evidence-based decision-making.
Go-To-Market Execution: Lead the local rollout of cross-functional initiatives, ensuring effective coordination across all departments.

d: We are looking for ambitious fresh graduates and final-year students to join our 2-month structured Internship Program in Bahrain!
This program is designed to give you hands-on experience inside a fast-paced global organization through real projects, active mentorship, and cross-functional exposure across our regional ecosystem.
People Operations (Tech/HR) - People Operations bridges high-growth talent acquisition with organizational scale, treating employees as internal customers to optimize both productivity and culture.

Marketing (Brand, CEM & Campaigns) - full-funnel acquisition, customer retention, and brand resonance by bridging creative brand activations with rigorous campaign analytics. The team creates targeted promotional campaigns, runs localized field activations, and continuously monitors Customer Experience Management (CEM) metrics to reduce churn.

tMart / Q-Commerce (Commercial) - The Commercial division of the quick-commerce grocery business focuses on gross merchandise value (GMV), product margins, and stock availability across darkstores. They negotiate key vendor terms, manage dynamic pricing, and build localized product assortments tailored to neighborhoods served by micro-fulfillment centers. Their ultimate objective is to maximize basket size and inventory turnover while minimizing write-offs and out-of-stock rates on high-velocity SKUs.

Sales (Operations & Account Management) - drives revenue by acquiring, onboarding, and scaling partnerships with merchants and B2B vendors. The team transitions partners from cold outreach to active onboarding, managing day-to-day account operations to maximize partner sales performance on the platform. By utilizing field sales tracking and structured account-management reviews, Sales protects merchant retention and unlocks upselling opportunities that increase platform revenue.
IT & Infrastructure (Darkstore Networking) - IT Infrastructure builds and maintains the foundational network stack required to run high-speed micro-fulfillment centers with zero downtime. .

Logistics (Vendor to Last-Mile Operations) - Logistics governs the physical movement of orders from vendor handover all the way through live dispatch and last-mile delivery. The division optimizes rider fleet allocation, refines dispatch algorithms, and enforces strict operational SLA thresholds to guarantee rapid delivery windows.
Own Real Deliverables: Work on live, impactful projects within your chosen function rather than side tasks.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner alongside experienced professionals locally and connect with regional teams across the MENA region.
Day-to-Day Execution: Gain practical exposure to how a tech-driven, fast-growing multinational operates.
Continuous Growth: Participate in feedback loops and mentorship sessions to accelerate your professional development.
